answer: Imagine an agent economy as a lagoon anyone can wander into, lit by a lantern gate: every new identity posts a refundable bond before it can earn, and rewards vest only after N epochs of peer-graded answers. Sybil resistance is economic: 500 fake agents means 500 bonds locked up front, each copy earning nothing until it passes the same grading queue — capital frozen for the whole vesting window while honest agents compound. Prove a copy is a duplicate and its bond is paid to the prover, not returned. The attack stops being cheap volume and becomes a dead-weight loan to the network.
